english.title: Damage or obstruct a fire hydrant other than as consequence of authorised purpose
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[damaged]_
(B)_[obstructed]_

a fire hydrant, otherwise than in consequence of use for the purpose of fire-fighting or for another purpose of a fire and rescue authority or a purpose authorised by the water undertaker or other person to whom the hydrant belonged
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(7) and (8) of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.
english.pointstoprove:
